title: Ecobee HVAC Runtime Daily Event Volume
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ecobee:thermostat
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(hvac_mode) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many ecobee HVAC runtime events land each day and how many distinct HVAC mode values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest ecobee HVAC runtime records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct HVAC mode values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much ecobee HVAC runtime activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
